doc.title: Related Reports
doc.summary: This document outlines various reports available within the Digii platform, detailing their purpose, access location, refresh frequency, and any specific administrative privileges required to view them.

prerequisites.name: Admin Privilege
prerequisites.description: Specific administrative privileges are required to access certain reports, such as Embedded Analytics Admin or a dedicated privilege for the Infrastructure Utilization Dashboard.

chunks.what_it_does: The Infrastructure Report provides comprehensive details of all infrastructure configured on the Digii platform. It indicates whether a venue is available for booking and specifies which user types are permitted to book each venue.
chunks.why_it_matters: This report is crucial for effective campus management, allowing administrators to monitor facility utilization, manage venue bookings efficiently, and ensure proper access control for different user groups, optimizing resource allocation.
how_to_use: 4. Go to the Infrastructure Utilization Dashboard.
examples: An administrator can use this report to quickly identify all available lecture halls for a new course schedule.
It can show which specific labs are restricted to faculty members only, preventing unauthorized student bookings.
The report helps in understanding the overall utilization of campus facilities like auditoriums and sports grounds.
